entities.summary: Swedish Reformation, a transformative movement in Sweden (1523–1560). Emerged from Catholic Church and Gustav Vasa elected King of Sweden, breaking from the Kalmar Union. Catalyzed Vasa Sons & Succession Crises and Peace of Westphalia.
